reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed the complete issuer-prepared September 10, 2026 weekly report on 2026-10-01. It reports Market Neutral Strategy $8,070,595.48, Settlement Reserve $65,124.54, and Settlement Funds in Process $75,478.00, totaling $8,211,198.02. These are broad accounting categories, not identified underlying positions or custody allocations. The existing 100% Re7-managed strategy NAV envelope was re-verified against this report and retains high risk, unknown liquidity, and 100% unresolved look-through exposure. The chainlink-nav adapter owns the live portfolio NAV row; report categories are not substituted for that row or treated as verified dependency weights.
